name: Clarify
description:
Connect Clarify and work with your CRM using natural language. Retrieve, create, and update records, analyze your pipeline, and generate insights—all through conversation.

Query deals, companies, people, and meetings without switching apps. Find and import new leads that match your ICP directly from the conversation. Create tasks, lists, and outbound sequences automatically.

Build and configure Clarify Agents from Claude to automate your entire GTM motion.

Your Clarify data is retrieved in real-time, and permissions are respected.

Stop clicking through interfaces. Just ask what you need.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Clarify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Clarify to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.clarify.ai/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Clarify MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Clarify lists 26 MCP tools, including get-current-user, get-schema, get-records, create-records, update-records, merge-records, query-data, add-comment, find-leads, import-leads, get-lists, and create-list.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Clarify?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Clarify in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.
Clarify requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Clarify is developed by Clarify. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
